reports.title: American Healthcare REIT Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results;

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Guidance
section: The Company is increasing NFFO per diluted share and Same-Store NOI growth guidance for the year ending December 31, 2026. The Company's 2026 guidance does not assume additional transaction or capital markets activity beyond the transactions or activity disclosed herein as completed. Guidance ranges are detailed below:

Metric | Midpoint | Current FY 2026 Range | Prior FY 2026 Range
Net income per diluted share | $0.605 | $0.59 to $0.62 | $0.54 to $0.58
NAREIT FFO per diluted share | $2.145 | $2.13 to $2.16 | $2.04 to $2.08
NFFO per diluted share | $2.245 | $2.23 to $2.26 | $2.15 to $2.19
Total Portfolio SS NOI Growth | 13.0% | 12.0% to 14.0% | 11.0% to 13.0%
ISHC | 15.5% | 14.5% to 16.5% | 13.0% to 16.0%
SHOP | 24.5% | 23.0% to 26.0% | 18.0% to 21.0%
Outpatient Medical | 0.75% | 0.5% to 1.0% | 0.0% to 1.0%
Triple-Net Leased Properties | 3.0% | 2.5% to 3.5% | 2.0% to 3.0%
